newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates rise to 6.75-7.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates rise to 6.75-7.00 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar rose on Sunday to 6.75-7.00 percent from six percent on Saturday, boosted by start of month salary transfers, dealers said.
"Major banks did not lend...Most bank withdrawals were related to salary transfers," one dealer said.

Banks cited tighter liquidity since the start of weekly trade with heavier subscription on the Central Bank's latest CD (certificate of deposit) and normal salary withdrawals at the start of every month.
